highlights.title: Sort your agents
highlights.line: The Agents grid and list can be sorted by name, model, role or project, by who needs you, or by recent activity.

highlights.title: Webhooks add tasks
highlights.line: A project's settings have Webhooks: calling a webhook's link adds a task to the project for a person.

highlights.title: Each agent's real model
highlights.line: Every agent's model is now shown by its real name, in plain language.

highlights.title: A rename reaches the whole page
highlights.line: Renaming an agent changes its name everywhere on its page straight away.

highlights.title: Steadier with many agents
highlights.line: Kosmos stays responsive while it delivers a message to many agents at once.
